title: The coffee-and-cup playbook
author: Editorial
excerpt: The best companion products do not compete with the hero — they complete the ritual. This is the playbook we use for coffee-and-cup launches. new upload

blocks.text: A companion product works when it extends a moment the buyer already wants. Coffee brands do not need another bag; they need the cup that makes the morning feel finished.
Map the ritual in three beats: anticipation, use, and share. Your companion should shine in the middle beat the part the hero product cannot own.
Price it as an add-on, not a downgrade. Bundle language matters: "complete the set" beats "also available." Limit colorways so the decision stays fast
Use the launch window to test one hero SKU plus one companion. Measure attach rate, not total SKUs. When attach rate climbs, you have a repeatable playbook — not a one-off merch idea.
